Container.Name: k2-horizon
Container.Overview: K2-Horizon models (IFM, 0.9B/3.7B/7B) on Intel Arc GPUs via Vulkan llama-server, with Ollama-style CLI (ollama run/pull/list) and OpenAI-compatible API. Experimental: upstream llama.cpp has not merged k2-horizon yet; built from the MBZUAI-IFM fork. Requires an Intel Arc GPU with /dev/dri on the host.
Container.Requires: Intel Arc GPU with kernel driver loaded (/dev/dri on host). First model download is several GB.

Config.Name: Model Storage
Config.Description: GGUF files (2-9 GB each) are downloaded here on first pull.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Port for the OpenAI-compatible API. 11436 default avoids clashing with Ollama on 11434/11435.

Config.Name: MODEL_ALIAS
Config.Description: Boot model, e.g. k2-horizon-0.9b (downloads ~0.7 GB on first boot). Empty = API only, load later with: ollama run k2-horizon-7b:Q4_K_M

Config.Name: CTX_SIZE
Config.Description: Context size for 0.9B/3.7B models (tokens; more = more VRAM).

Config.Name: CTX_SIZE_7B
Config.Description: Context size for 7B models (tighter VRAM budget on 6 GB cards).

Config.Name: REASONING_BUDGET
Config.Description: Max thinking tokens per reply (default 1024). Lower = faster but dumber answers; -1 = unlimited (runaway thinking).

Config.Name: REASONING
Config.Description: on/off/auto. Set to off to disable thinking entirely (empty = model default).
